page_title: PSG 1-3 NIC | PSG v Nice 25/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
90+8' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

90+7' A pass from Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is intercepted by Marcin Bulka and the move breaks down. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+7' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90+4' Bradley Barcola (PSG) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
90+3' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' A snap shot by Vitinha (PSG) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Marcin Bulka produces a good save to thwart him.
90+2' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+1' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Goncalo Ramos (PSG) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Marcin Bulka pulls off a brilliant save.
90+1' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
86' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Evann Guessand (Nice) replaces Gaetan Laborde.
86' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Ali Abdi (Nice) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Tom Louchet.
84' Ali Abdi (Nice) picks up an injury.
82' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
80' Willy Delajod blows for a foul after Gaetan Laborde (Nice) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. PSG win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
78' Substitution. Fabian Ruiz will be replaced by Senny Mayulu (PSG).
76' The current number of shots on goal is 8:3.
75' Problems for Franck Haise as Badredine Bouanani is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Sofiane Diop (Nice) replaces him.
74' Badredine Bouanani (Nice) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
72' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) for his blatant foul.

70' 1 - 3 Perfectly taken free kick! Badredine Bouanani sends the ball in, Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a cracking header into the middle of the net. It's 1:3.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is brought on as a substitute for Marquinhos.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) will replace Ousmane Dembele.
68' Nuno Mendes (PSG) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
67' Franck Haise has decided to substitute Morgan Sanson and he is replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Nice).
67' Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) is substituted due to injury. Franck Haise gives a chance to Antoine Mendy.

66' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Marcin Bulka, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
65' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
64' Looks like Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
63' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
63' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

63' Vitinha (PSG) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Marcin Bulka to dive and make a save. PSG force a corner. They send men into the box.
62' Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) was too forceful with his tackle and Willy Delajod interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
59' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Joao Neves is replaced by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
59' Bradley Barcola (PSG) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Desire Doue.
59' Desire Doue (PSG) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
58' The game is interrupted as Ali Abdi (Nice) is flagged offside.
57' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
56' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
55' Ali Abdi (Nice) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
53' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Badredine Bouanani (Nice) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
53' Willy Delajod blows his whistle. Joao Neves (PSG) commits a foul after dangerous play.
51' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
48' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.

46' 1 - 2 Jonathan Clauss sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Morgan Sanson (Nice) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:2.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Joao Neves (PSG) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
45+2' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45+1' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Willy Delajod blows for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ali Abdi (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
44' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ali Abdi (Nice) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Ali Abdi (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
43' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

41' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Fabian Ruiz (PSG) scores with a brilliant low shot into the middle of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Ousmane Dembele. The score is now 1:1.
39' Desire Doue (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
38' Desire Doue (PSG) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

38' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, PSG are going to take it.
34' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Badredine Bouanani sets up Morgan Sanson (Nice) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
34' Joao Neves (PSG) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call.
33' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to PSG.
32' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
31' The ball falls kindly for Desire Doue (PSG) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
31' What a huge chance for Ousmane Dembele (PSG). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
30' Ali Abdi (Nice) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
29' The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.
28' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
27' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
26' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
24' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
21' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Marcin Bulka pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
20' Desire Doue (PSG) is able to continue to play.
19' Desire Doue (PSG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Neat passing move from PSG in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' A pass by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Desire Doue (PSG) takes it short.
14' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Willy Delajod has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
12' PSG failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
11' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (PSG) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
8' The corner from Desire Doue (PSG) is cleared away by the defence.
8' Nuno Mendes (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
5' The referee blows his whistle as Ali Abdi (Nice) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' PSG control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half has started.
PSG will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Willy Delajod.
